source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The new max-content minimum applies to .button-small. The accepted Publish control is an HTML button, while expiry and external-key removal are XUL buttons with that same class. Publish shares an hbox with a description. The CSS comment's all-HTML wording must not replace these actual element roles, and the source constraint is separate from a rendered clipping or localization result.
title: The small OpenPGP button rule covers both HTML and XUL controls
